description: Checks a parent's message for signs it needs urgent help (emergency, poison, fever in a young baby, breathing, self-harm and similar) and returns who to call and the reviewed warning signs for each stage. Call it first whenever a message mentions a symptom, an injury, something swallowed, or a parent struggling. With no text, it returns the numbers and warning signs.
name: get_help
title: Check whether a parent needs urgent help
